reserveReview.rationale: Observed 2026-10-01: Gold Token SA's live registry reports Base, Ethereum and Solana in matched reconciliation state, with dated reconCheckedAt observations on October 1. Each network reports identical token supply and backedWeight and a zero gap. The live bar registry identifies the corresponding serial-numbered PAMP bars; redeemed bars are explicitly distinguished from live bars. This checkpoint supports the unchanged 100% allocation to physical PAMP gold and is issuer-maintained reconciliation, not independent assurance.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Gold Token SA live bar registry reconciliation of all issued DGLD across Base, Ethereum and Solana to serial-numbered allocated PAMP bars
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Each active network reports token supply matched to allocated PAMP bar weight with a zero gap at its October 1 reconciliation checkpoint. Independent physical-vault verification and independently audited reserve-to-liability assurance are not established by this issuer-maintained registry.
